name: Do I need to move all my furniture before interior painting?

mainEntity.name: Do I need to move all my furniture before interior painting?

acceptedAnswer.text: While you don't always need to remove every single item from a room, clearing out as much as possible is highly recommended. Smaller, movable items should be completely removed. Larger furniture can often be shifted to the center of the room and covered securely with plastic sheeting to protect them from dust and paint splatters. This helps painters work more efficiently and reduces the risk of damage to your belongings, ensuring a cleaner and safer work environment.
acceptedAnswer.description: Move small items completely and shift larger furniture to the room's center, covering it to protect from paint and allow painters better access.
